title: Alan Turing
summary: Born in London on 23 June 1912, Turing described the abstract machine now named after him in a paper published in 1936. After war was declared in 1939 he worked full time at Bletchley Park on breaking Enigma, and his Hut 8 section deciphered naval messages. He later worked on early computers at the National Physical Laboratory and Manchester, and died at his home in Wilmslow, Cheshire, in June 1954.

uncertainty.note: Sources differ on the death date: MacTutor and the Science Museum Group give 7 June 1954; King's College Cambridge gives 8 June; Hodges says he died the day before he was found on 8 June.
